precedence: The integrated SPEC.html and this contract override alternative schedules in technical_notes/
task: Okada Mei Turkey SP first shot: one physical camera and one shared scene
confirmed_facts: all source material identities manually reviewed
all original per-frame UV observations manually reviewed and accepted as valid

input.repeated_source_id_semantics: never deduplicate by source_point_id or infer a shared world station from repetition
input.pixel_centers: integer coordinates; x right, y down
input.identity_policy: preserve all records, original UV, material IDs and PTS; no residual-based deletion or relabeling

observation_semantics.ordinary_curve: finite 2D localization with unknown legal continuous S; not a fabricated persistent point
observation_semantics.physical_corner_or_endpoint: fixed world identity; cannot slide along material
observation_semantics.cropped_or_occluded_run_endpoint: free material station unless independently confirmed as a physical endpoint
observation_semantics.true_profile: query equality + normal localization + finite query/material interval; no invented profile metadata
observation_semantics.profile_units: native error e_n in pixels; statistical residual r_n=e_n/sigma_n; pixel budget uses e_n only
observation_semantics.profile_no_intersection_recovery: retain explicit (s,alpha) with prediction-u-alpha*n=0 and finite interval via equality AL; restore before exact intersection/elimination
observation_semantics.order: only verified trace/run order; nondecreasing stations allow equality; unverified order stays a candidate
observation_semantics.reverse_coverage: only for confirmed completely visible and completely sampled contours
observation_semantics.persistent_track: shared material station only with evidence of the same physical point; repeated source_point_id alone is insufficient

no_profile_no_tolerance_default.meaning: explicit engineering target; not measured sigma or a confidence interval

pixel_budget.evidence_supported_anisotropy: freeze from existing localization/profile evidence before any fit
pixel_budget.actual_coverage: t_hat = sqrt(max_i q_i), independently recomputed from raw predictions
prohibited: subtracting fitted common mode from coverage

statistics.default_loss: squared error under existing valid grouped W or fixed covariance
statistics.preserve: group membership, ordering, rank and covariance provenance
statistics.missing_statistics: declare and freeze an uncalibrated engineering scale; do not call it measured sigma
statistics.robust_allowed_only_if: separate frozen evidence supports the heavy-tail model
statistics.common_mode: finite declared covariance; use the hierarchical model OR equivalent full W, never both
statistics.motion_evidence: do not independently reweight flow derived from the same original pixels

final_model.scene: one continuous shared ice/board/material scene; static shared logo shape blocks
final_model.gauge: Z=0; named origin and long-axis direction; fixed handedness/mirror; rink length L=1 unless independently measured
final_model.angle_gauge: alpha(t_ref)=beta(t_ref)=0 by exact function-value elimination, not one coefficient fixed to zero
final_model.camera: exact fixed-head chain of spec_body.html; fixed P, shared axes and lever geometry
final_model.time_basis: native-frame local cubic B-spline controls for alpha, beta, log focal
final_model.nominal_time_controls: approximately 3*1248 plus boundary extension minus exact gauges
final_model.rolling_shutter: shared tau; implicit predicted-row projection; safeguarded Newton/Brent; correct implicit derivatives
final_model.RS_missing_root_recovery: retain explicit v with h_RS=v-pi_y(X,t_k(v))=0 via equality AL; positive depth and true arithmetic domains still checked
final_model.auxiliary_root_semantics: equivalent equality auxiliaries, not image warp; must restore root/query equalities and pass true implicit non-singular-root replay
final_model.time_boundary: cover half readout outside endpoint frame centers; no clamping and no interpolation across cuts
final_model.final_delta_xi_parameters: absent; deleted from both state and factor graph
final_model.curve_S: explicit legal variables optimized jointly with the complete current AL objective

seed_sources: relative plane registration / supported rotation-zoom approximation
Euclidean directions and common-plane geometry with explicit atlas upgrade
initialization.insufficient_seed_information: record limitation; do not fabricate constraints or basins
initialization.bridge: conditional fallback only; all frames share the scene and low-dimensional optics; first R/log f then supported center directions
initialization.direct_physical_branch: retain independent installation/geometry fixed-head seeds; skip optional bridge if direct physical candidate passes
initialization.head_retraction: fit axes/angles and [P,d,a] from bridge as initialization; finite continuation with Exp(delta_xi)*T_head
initialization.redundancy_control: do not free redundant head and delta streams at zero penalty
initialization.final_retraction: delete delta_xi, rebuild exact physical graph, reoptimize all original observations
initialization.comparison: compare local H only on identical declared supports; complete physical states on all original obligations with fixed E/W
initialization.optical_candidates: finite evidence-supported low-dimensional variants from the same baseline; no untracked parameter release
initialization.primary_route: surface-specific registration -> offline keyframe graph -> explicit atlas metric upgrade and common camera -> exact fixed head -> full-source native feasibility
initialization.bridge_trigger: unexplained native mechanical gap after matching optical/output assumptions, or degenerate planar metric upgrade with usable other 3D material support
initialization.physical_state_snapshot: deep immutable whole-shot state including geometry/S/branches/optics/objective version and raw ledger; no mutable tensor aliases or best-frame splicing

phases.phase_I: min b subject to every q_i<=b, physical/support/order/query constraints
phases.phase_I_budget_residual: sqrt(2*b+1); half square = b+1/2; no robust loss
phases.phase_I_secondary_terms: no arbitrary weighted statistical/smoothing objective blocking feasibility; common mode inactive
phases.phase_I_early_transition: physical/support-valid actual t_hat<=1 is sufficient; no need to minimize noise to zero
phases.phase_II: fix b=1; minimize F_px + measured priors + time-smoothness, retaining all constraints
phases.phase_II_budget_semantics: may use the original unit budget even if phase I achieved t_hat<1
phases.completion: after phase II, independently replay final state and complete acceptance plus exports; one iteration is not completion

numerical_backend.general_constraints: external PHR AL; not a native Ceres general-constraint solver
numerical_backend.sparse_graph: retain shared shape, long tracks and correlations; no claimed global banded/O(N) structure
numerical_backend.local_elimination: First version: Schur of the joint damped LM linear system only, with correct active constraints; leave coupled/active/ambiguous S explicit. A nonlinear S*(x) objective requires a separately derived inner KKT without automatically adding LM damping.
numerical_backend.active_or_ambiguous_S: keep explicit; finite bounds; verified non-strict order via inequality AL
numerical_backend.jacobian_policy: fresh at changed state/branch/model/outer lambda/rho; complete S dependence
numerical_backend.trial_policy: same-objective predicted/actual decrease; reject true-domain failures and shrink trust region; no post-step recovery

phr.penalty_update: multiply rho by 5 if V exceeds 0.5*previous_V; otherwise retain
phr.inner_accuracy: reach configured accuracy or explicitly log and handle declared inexact status before updating multipliers
phr.stopping: actual primal/equality violation, nonnegative lambda, complementarity, scaled projected Lagrangian gradient
phr.phase_I_budget_stationarity: if b>0, sum(pixel_constraint_lambda) approximately 1; include b-bound multiplier at b=0
phr.rho_limit_or_factorization_failure: numerically limited; never a success or global-infeasibility certificate

suggested_initial_runtime_defaults.meaning: Engineering starting settings to validate and freeze before production; not measured convergence guarantees

mandatory: all 182017 observations accounted for across 1248 frames
actual t_hat<=1 within separately logged frozen arithmetic tolerance
exact physical graph with delta absent
acceptance.independent_identifiability: profile weak physical directions with nuisance reoptimization; data information excludes damping/priors
acceptance.failures: preserve best concrete physical state, complete violations and tested hypotheses; do not claim global nonexistence
acceptance.one_iteration_only: diagnostic checkpoint; automatically continue toward full phase II and final acceptance
final_outputs: registration support/rank/graph provenance and same-support comparator ledger
acceptance.rendering: same forward model; adaptive curve tessellation chord error <=0.1 px

registration_frontend.homography_direction: H_tp maps plane-component atlas coordinates to native image; G_ji maps native frame i to j
registration_frontend.surfaces: ice and genuine planar board faces; constant-height boundary curves may lie in parallel horizontal planes; curved board sheets remain 3D
registration_frontend.raw_H_model: explicit global-shutter/undistorted approximation, not a general physical lower bound
registration_frontend.atlas_gauge: one reference H=I per genuine connected planar component; disconnected components remain unaligned; shared observed geometry determines connectivity
registration_frontend.unknown_template: one shared static shape with provenance; no old-q inverse projection frozen as true metric shape
registration_frontend.metric_upgrade: q=Q_p xi, physical embedding M_p, H_atlas Q_p ~ P_t M_p; A_p=M_p inverse(Q_p), not an arbitrary physical 4x3 block
registration_frontend.IAC: omega=K^-T K^-1; orthogonal/equal-norm column constraints only after Euclidean chart upgrade
registration_frontend.rank: normalized actual residual Jacobian; preserve weak directions; unknown-station circle alone cannot determine general H
registration_frontend.parameterization: nondegenerate virtual four-control-point or equivalent local projective chart; no new measurements
registration_frontend.unsupported_records: mark not_applicable for this local comparator; retain original obligations; no global t_hat from partial model
registration_frontend.candidate_scoring: identical frozen support set per comparator; snapshot native finite-material residual and query/support status
registration_frontend.varying_intrinsics: do not stack zoom-varying H into fixed-K calibration; use shared low-dimensional K/f(t) with rank checks

capture_surrogate.default: normalized positive quadrature log-sum-exp finite same-material distance, sigma>0; initializer only
capture_surrogate.formula: E_sigma_i=-2 sigma^2 log(sum_j a_j exp(-d_ij^2/(2 sigma^2))); a_j>0, sum a_j=1
capture_surrogate.source_group_normalization: 1/N_tm for capture only, not final statistical weights or coverage
capture_surrogate.state_dependent: projected coordinates vary; never freeze projected samples while optimizing the camera
capture_surrogate.sampling_fill_distance_native: <= sigma_native/4 in the actual support; rebuild local model after resampling/kernel/scale change
capture_surrogate.positive_bias: finite sigma depends on quadrature and may be positive even on curve; not exact nearest distance or measured likelihood
capture_surrogate.alternative_distance_field: separate surrogate_id with its own objective/gradient; ordinary EDT is not equivalent to the chosen soft-min
capture_surrogate.settings_status: engineering capture settings to validate and freeze, not source-paper parameters or pixel budgets
capture_surrogate.pixel_centers: u_s=s*(u+0.5)-0.5; T_s linear sI and translation (s-1)/2
capture_surrogate.transform_scaling: H_s=T_s H for unchanged atlas; G_sj_si=T_sj G inverse(T_si)
capture_surrogate.run_policy: use only verified connectivity/order; no array-order polyline inference or crop-as-physical-endpoint
capture_surrogate.reverse_coverage: only confirmed complete visible sampled runs
capture_surrogate.exit: replay local native support, then exact continuous material residual before physical acceptance
capture_surrogate.native_objective_during_capture: can worsen while exploring; keep best native-support snapshots; final physical acceptance uses all O

registration_graph.anchor_choice: information coverage, nonparallel directions, plane co-visibility, image quality, zoom span and true revisits; not first-frame-only
registration_graph.propagation: multiple anchors, forwards and backwards, then global graph adjustment
registration_graph.loop_check: independently estimated pairwise transforms evaluated as native point displacement; never edges synthesized from same H
registration_graph.statistical_caveat: shared pixels are correlated; loops are consistency checks, not independent ground truth
registration_graph.persistence: same physical point only with evidence; repeated IDs or sampling index insufficient
registration_graph.missing_support: leave weak/unknown and obtain conditional initialization from other surfaces/global head; no fake successful propagation
registration_graph.final_factor_policy: remove derived H/flow/pose pseudo-observations before final all-source physical solve
registration_graph.adaptive_template: immutable structure and UV; shared external-appearance layer carries provenance/version/uncertainty and cannot self-certify
registration_graph.temporary_cross_prediction: whole material/time blocks before final all-observation fitting

state_stages.S0: immutable inventory, semantics, budgets and full shared scene
state_stages.S2: offline keyframe graph with connected component gauges
state_stages.S3: explicit metric upgrade/common camera, exact fixed head, conditional bridge and exact retraction
state_stages.S4: min b subject to every q_i<=b, physical/support/order/query constraints
state_stages.S5: fix b=1; minimize F_px + measured priors + time-smoothness, retaining all constraints
state_stages.S6: independent physical replay, all native obligations, weak profiles and exports

source_audit.patent_formula_policy: independently derive MI/IAC; printed formulas not copied
source_audit.WACV2022_scope: synthetic self-supervised pretraining; sports adaptation uses GT H; no claimed official implementation found in this review

registration_sampling_contract.energy_scaling: E_s=s^2*E_native for squared-distance capture; export native units
registration_sampling_contract.finite_kernel_bias: broad normalized kernels may attract to a single long curve average or average across branches; native support replay remains required
